question: What is the use of the functional key F7 in Microsoft Word 2010?

options.text: It is used as a search key.
It is used to run spell check and grammar check.
It is used for renaming files and folders.
It is used to open the Help window.

solution:
The correct answer is**__ __**__**It is used to run spell-check and grammar checks.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Its have** no use** of the **F7 key in Windows.**
 
• **In Microsoft programs** such as Microsoft Word, Outlook for **checking spellings and grammar, the F7 **is commonly used.
 
• **Other uses- **
 
 
• **Shift + F7** = Choose the Thesaurus command.
 
• **Ctrl + F7** = Choose the move command.
 
• **Alt + F7 **= Find the next misspelling or grammatical error.
 
 

 
• Renaming files and folders**- F2 key.**
 
• Opening help- Windows Key** + F1 key.**
 
• Searching content in various apps**- Windows Key + Q key.**
